view.welcome.name: Query
view.welcome.contents:
Browse and query InterSystems IRIS table schema, class definitions and ER diagrams.

Connections are read from the `intersystems.servers` setting (Server Manager).

[Open Query Panel](command:irisSchema.openPanel)
[Reload Connections](command:irisSchema.refreshConnections)

You can also open it from the editor title bar of any `.cls` file.
cmd.openPanel.title: Open Query Panel
cmd.refreshConnections.title: Reload Connections
cmd.clearPasswords.title: Clear Stored Passwords
config.configPath.description: Path to an extra connection file. Left empty, ~/.iris-schema.json is used (shared with the iris-schema skill). Server connections come primarily from the intersystems.servers setting; entries with the same name are merged, and missing fields (such as namespace) are filled in from this file.
config.sampleLimit.description: Maximum number of rows returned when querying data
